fusions.name: Shrugged Landslide
fusions.desc: Shrugs the stone off your back in a spread of 3 boulders out to 6 tiles; each one deals 8 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spalled Plate
fusions.desc: Breaks a stone plate off your shell over the target at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, which deals 10 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nest in the Scree
fusions.desc: Buries a clutch of stone eggs at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off, which deals 24 damage.

fusions.name: Fault Under Strain
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
